jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Quik Hire Staffing is a leading recruitment agency dedicated to connecting talented professionals with innovative organizations across various industries. With a focus on technology, engineering, and digital transformation, Quik Hire Staffing prides itself on delivering tailored staffing solutions that meet the unique needs of each client. Our commitment to excellence, integrity, and diversity ensures that both our clients and candidates receive exceptional service and support throughout the hiring process. We leverage extensive industry knowledge and a vast network of professionals to facilitate successful placements that drive organizational growth and individual career development.

About The Role

We are currently seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer specializing in Ruby to join our client's dynamic team on a full-time, remote basis. This role focuses on evaluating and validating large language models (LLMs) by developing datasets and benchmarks that simulate real-world software engineering challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Ruby development, experience working with complex codebases, and a passion for advancing AI-driven software solutions. You will collaborate closely with AI researchers and contribute to projects aimed at enhancing LLM performance in tasks such as bug fixing and code completion. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of AI-assisted programming tools and to work within a cutting-edge technological environment.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of three years of professional experience in software engineering, with a strong proficiency in Ruby and Ruby on Rails. Demonstrated expertise in version control systems such as Git, containerization tools like Docker, and experience setting up reproducible software pipelines are essential. Candidates should have the ability to understand and navigate complex, real-world codebases, and possess the skills to run, modify, and test code locally. Familiarity with Ruby testing frameworks such as RSpec and Minitest, as well as gem management using Bundler, is required. Prior contributions to open-source projects or experience evaluating open-source repositories will be considered a plus. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment are also important qualifications.

Responsibilities

Analyze and triage issues from trending open-source repositories on GitHub to identify suitable evaluation scenarios for LLM benchmarking.
Set up and configure code repositories, including creating Docker containers and preparing environments to ensure reproducibility of tests.
Assess unit test coverage and code quality metrics to establish baseline health and robustness of software projects.
Modify, run, and debug Ruby codebases locally to evaluate LLM performance in bug fixing, code completion, and other software engineering tasks.
Collaborate with AI research teams to select repositories and issues that present challenging and meaningful scenarios for model evaluation.
Document findings, develop testing protocols, and contribute to the continuous improvement of evaluation methodologies.

Benefits

Joining this role provides access to a competitive benefits package, including flexible remote working arrangements, professional development opportunities, and exposure to pioneering AI research projects. You will work alongside industry experts and innovative teams committed to technological advancement. Additionally, the position offers a supportive environment that encourages continuous learning, collaboration, and career growth within the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. The company also values work-life balance and promotes a healthy, inclusive workplace culture that respects diversity and individual contributions.

Equal Opportunity

Quik Hire Staffing is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in fostering an inclusive environment where all candidates are evaluated based on their skills, experience, and qualifications. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring process is designed to ensure fairness and transparency, and we welcome applications from diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and the work we do.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About The Company

Meril is a leading global healthcare company dedicated to developing innovative medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and consumer health products. With a commitment to improving patient outcomes and enhancing quality of life, Meril leverages cutting-edge technology and scientific research to deliver high-quality solutions across various healthcare segments. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. Meril’s global presence and diverse portfolio make it a preferred employer for talented individuals seeking to make a meaningful impact in the healthcare industry.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical AI/ML & Strategy Exploration Intern to join our dynamic team at Meril in Bangalore. This internship offers an excellent opportunity for candidates passionate about machine learning, data science, and strategic problem-solving to gain practical experience in a fast-paced healthcare environment. The selected intern will work closely with our AI/ML and research teams, supporting various activities related to data analysis, model validation, and strategy development. This role is ideal for students who are eager to apply their academic knowledge to real-world challenges, develop their technical skills, and contribute meaningfully to innovative projects.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess a strong foundation in problem-solving, mathematics, and statistics, with a keen interest in machine learning concepts. Applicants must be pursuing a B.Tech/B.E. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, with an expected graduation year of 2026. Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with data-processing libraries such as NumPy and Pandas are preferred. Candidates should demonstrate strong analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and a curiosity to learn and tackle challenging problems. Additionally, good communication skills and the ability to interpret data insights effectively are essential.

Responsibilities

Prepare, clean, organize, and analyze datasets for AI/ML and strategic projects to ensure data integrity and usability.
Perform data preprocessing tasks, including feature engineering and statistical analysis, to support model development.
Assist in manual evaluation and validation of machine learning model outputs to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Explore datasets to identify patterns, trends, relationships, and potential signals that can inform strategic decisions.
Support the exploration and evaluation of data-driven strategies, contributing to innovative solutions.
Apply fundamental mathematics, statistics, and machine learning concepts to solve practical problems in healthcare and related domains.
Contribute to testing, validating, and refining models, strategies, and analytical results to ensure robustness.
Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and derive meaningful insights to optimize project outcomes.
Document findings, observations, and analysis clearly for internal reporting and future reference.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including AI/ML researchers and business stakeholders, to achieve project goals.
Take ownership of assigned tasks, approaching problems with a structured, logical, and solution-oriented mindset.

Benefits

As an intern at Meril, you will gain valuable hands-on experience working on cutting-edge projects in the healthcare technology space. You will have the opportunity to learn from industry experts and contribute to impactful solutions that improve patient care. The internship includes mentorship from experienced professionals, exposure to real-world data challenges, and the chance to develop technical and strategic skills in a collaborative environment. Successful interns may be considered for full-time employment, offering a pathway to a rewarding career with Meril. Additionally, interns will have access to various learning resources, networking opportunities, and the chance to work on innovative projects that make a difference in healthcare.

Equal Opportunity

Meril is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation and excellence, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. We encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our mission to improve healthcare worldwide.
